svg.text: Schematic of the rebuilt town (circa 1491 DR), from the labelled Essentials Kit town map. Not to scale.
Positions are traced by eye from the labelled town map (File:Leilon imagery.jpg). The map is an oblique painting, so distances are approximate.
Houses are scattered to show the built-up area, not plotted one by one. Outbuildings, islands and the mudflat edge are simplified.
Sketched 2026-10-11 for the Faerun Economy Engine wiki. A working reconstruction, not a copy of the published map.
